title: Nuvei Setup Guide
summary: Guide for configuring Nuvei sandbox credentials, DMN webhooks, checksum validation, sandbox test cards, and troubleshooting payment notifications.
requirements: Configure NUVEI_MERCHANT_ID, NUVEI_MERCHANT_SITE_ID, NUVEI_SECRET_KEY, and NUVEI_API_BASE_URL from Nuvei sandbox credentials.
Configure the Nuvei DMN URL from postDeploy output at the /webhooks/nuvei endpoint in the Nuvei dashboard.
Set Nuvei DMN notification type to Post using form-encoded or JSON payloads.
Validate DMN advanceResponseChecksum before accepting notifications and reject mismatches with HTTP 400.
Handle duplicate DMNs idempotently by checking for existing commercetools Payment transactions with the same Nuvei interactionId.
Handle known Nuvei DMN field casing variations for TransactionID and PPP_TransactionID.
constraints: Sandbox API base URL is typically https://ppp-test.nuvei.com/ppp/api/v1 but must be confirmed for the Nuvei region.
DMN checksum defaults to SHA-256 and can be set to MD5 with NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM.
DMN checksum formula is secretKey + totalAmount + currency + responseTimeStamp + PPP_TransactionID + Status + productId.
Checksum comparison must use timing-safe comparison.

Expected payment actions map Authorize to openOrder/widget/DMN Auth and Authorization Success, Capture to settleTransaction and Charge Success, Cancel to voidTransaction and CancelAuthorization Success, and Refund to refundTransaction and Refund Success.
notes: Manifest declared DOC; classification uses manifest override. Document is an operational setup guide with technical constraints but no ADR, PRD, or full technical specification structure.
